task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    index:
        product: thunderbird
    worker-type: b-linux-docker-amd
    worker:
        artifacts:
            - name: public/build/security/browser.xml
              path: checkouts/gecko/comm/build/macosx/hardenedruntime/v2/{entitlement_directory}/browser.xml
              type: file
            - name: public/build/security/media-plugin-helper.xml
              path: checkouts/gecko/comm/build/macosx/hardenedruntime/v2/{entitlement_directory}/media-plugin-helper.xml
              type: file
            - name: public/build/security/plugin-container.xml
              path: checkouts/gecko/comm/build/macosx/hardenedruntime/v2/{entitlement_directory}/plugin-container.xml
              type: file
            - name: public/build/security/security-module-helper.xml
              path: checkouts/gecko/comm/build/macosx/hardenedruntime/v2/{entitlement_directory}/security-module-helper.xml
              type: file
    run:
        using: mozharness
        comm-checkout: true
        clone-with: hg
        actions: [build]
        config-paths:
            - comm/testing/mozharness/configs
        script: "mozharness/scripts/fx_desktop_build.py"
    optimization:
        never: null
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-cbindgen
            - linux64-cctools-port
            - linux64-clang
            - linux64-dump_syms
            - linux64-hfsplus
            - linux64-libdmg
            - linux64-nasm
            - linux64-node
